landing.metaTitle: Digital Invitation Cards Tanzania | Harusi Pass
landing.heroTitle: One wedding card that reaches every guest, collects replies and contributions, and opens the gate.
landing.heroBody: WhatsApp, SMS or paper — every guest gets their own card with a QR and a number. Even without a smartphone, even without a network.

1.title: Add guests
1.body: Paste a list, upload a CSV or pick from phone contacts. We clean up every number.

2.title: Send cards
2.body: WhatsApp for smartphones, SMS for everyone else, and a printable PDF for elders.

3.title: Guests reply & pay
3.body: Guests confirm and pay their contribution by phone — no account needed.

4.title: Arrive at the gate
4.body: The committee scans the QR or types the number. It works even when the network drops.

landing.featureBody: Every guest gets a short number like KH-4826 by SMS or on a paper card. At the gate, the committee finds them by number, name or the last four digits of their phone.
landing.featureSms: An SMS that reads on any phone
landing.featurePrint: A paper card with QR and number
landing.featureGate: At the gate: QR, number or name

sender.title: You can see who sent it
sender.body: Every card shows the committee's name, their phone and the official link.

links.title: No scam links
links.body: We never ask for passwords or PINs, and we never send attachments or apps.

data.title: Your data stays yours
data.body: Guest numbers are used for your event only. Download or delete them at any time.

1.q: Can we still have paper cards?
1.a: Yes. Download a PDF of all cards — each with the guest's QR and number — and print anywhere.

2.q: How does a guest without a smartphone get a card?
2.a: They receive an SMS with a short link and their card number. At the gate they just say the number.

3.q: What if the network drops on the wedding day?
3.a: The gate app checks QR codes without a network and syncs later. The guest's card also shows offline after the first open.

4.a: Guests pay with M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money or HaloPesa from their card. The committee can also record cash.

5.q: What if someone photographs another guest's QR?
5.a: Each QR belongs to one guest and admits once. A second scan shows the committee who entered and when.

6.a: It is free during the pilot. SMS costs are shown before sending.

landing.footerTagline: Made in Tanzania for Tanzanian weddings and celebrations.
landing.metaDescription: Create digital invitation cards for weddings, send-offs, birthdays and more. Send by WhatsApp, SMS or paper. Track replies and contributions, and admit guests at the gate by QR, even offline.
landing.definition: Harusi Pass is a Tanzanian service for online invitations. Every guest gets their own card by WhatsApp, SMS or paper, with a QR and a short number. The committee sees who replied, who contributed and who arrived at the gate, even when the network drops.
